_doc: Config for expansion 3.3 (low-relief slope stratification, then edits). Path specs resolve through expkit (path_for / area_dir / exp_dir). Items marked assumed are not held yet; the scripts fail with a message naming them.
_proposal_note: fw_00 section 4 says cut at 0.10. On 9t fold 0 that gives recall 0.553 before any budget against 0.922 at the archival cutoff, because low cutoffs merge blobs and fail IoU 0.3. loo_max_recall reproduces the archival sweep rule. Set fixed to use proposal_thr. Build agent decision 2026-11-05.
_margin_note: User decision. Loss in recall points that would change the decision to try a flat county. Set before step 1 scoring is used for a gate. null means intervals are reported with decision no_margin_set.
